objective: Phase 1: Replace regex-only planner with LLM planner (Ollama) while preserving regex as named control
acceptance_criteria: Planner protocol accepts task text, available tools, delegation targets, principal-chain context, and instruction provenance
Planner returns validated decision types (tool_call, delegate, respond, refuse) rejecting malformed or extra actions
Current regex rules moved into RegexPlanner without silent fallback on LLM error
Ollama adapter implements configurable model name/digest, temperature, top-p, seed, timeout, max tokens, prompt template version
Input segments labeled by provenance (user_input, a2a_message, mcp_tool_result, delegated_response) with structured schemas
Planning events log raw response hash, normalized decision, model digest, sampling config, seed, duration, parser error, explicit fallback
Ten repeated LLM smoke runs finish with no hidden fallback
Designated variance scenario produces at least two distinct normalized traces or outcomes
Separate regex-control and LLM result sets emitted in evaluation
All unit and contract tests pass (test_planner_contract, test_ollama_parser, test_fallback, test_provenance_labels)
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 2 attestation or registry until Phase 1 is green
Do not remove regex planner (keep as explicit control baseline)
